tools.name: get_applicable_obligations
tools.description: Use this when you need the obligations themselves for one assessed system rather than the classification picture: which obligations apply, which possibly apply, from when, why, and on which source and locator. Returns one entry per assessed obligation, filtered by applicability. A version 2 profile

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_source_provenance, request_expert_review · Private data: explain_applicability, get_source_provenance, get_national_enforcement, export_dpia_intake, answer_question · Public sink: check_case, export_dpia_intake, request_expert_review.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_source_provenance, request_expert_review · Private data: explain_applicability, get_source_provenance, get_national_enforcement, export_dpia_intake, answer_question · Public sink: check_case, export_dpia_intake, request_expert_review

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "explain_applicability" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
